summary: Itaú Unibanco filed a Form 6-K furnishing summarized minutes of its Board of Directors meeting on April 30, 2026. The Board set the number of officer seats at 48 for the upcoming annual term, re-elected 48 existing officers, and elected three new officers (Carlos Eduardo de Almeida Mazzei, Nuno Filipe Bonito Monteiro, and Renato Giongo Vichi). No mention of price, terms, or external advisors. This constitutes routine management changes rather than a strategic event or special situation. The filing also references the prior Annual and Extraordinary General Stockholders Meeting held on April 28, 2026. No urgent risk-arb angle or transaction watch is warranted.
